Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Party: Bells anywhere
Metadata.Author: bbport, after Wozzardman/shadp2p
Metadata.Note: Party co-op (BB_PARTY; BB_PARTY_SEAMLESS=0 turns it off): the Beckoning, Small Resonant and Sinister bells work in every area, also negative SOS areas (defeated-boss regions, Hunter's Dream). Beckoning range check 0x157f8c8 unsigned ja -> signed jg and its area-flag result 0x157f960 allowed; Small/Sinister availability 0x157f6d1/0x157f6d3 allowed through the checked epilogue; active-bell updater 0x1506820 range 0x15068bb signed and area flag 0x15068fc allowed (effect 9003, not the X 9004); responder search range 0x191a8c3 signed; SOS status area result 0x18700d3 (from the area validator 0x131d7b0) allowed. Original attribute: the 1.09 bytes, checked by patches.py.

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Party: Bells after boss defeated
Metadata.Author: bbport, after Wozzardman/shadp2p
Metadata.Note: Party co-op: summons still build after the area boss is dead and across maps. NOPs the summon builder's area-event rejection 0x18749e8 (the validator 0x131d7b0 reports the boss-cleared flag, e.g. 2410), its negative event id rejection 0x18749f0, the candidate's responder-area mismatch 0x14b714a, and makes the builder's area jump 0x1874b79 unconditional.

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Party: Keep session on map reload
Metadata.Author: bbport, after Wozzardman/shadp2p
Metadata.Note: Party co-op: the stage task destructor 0x19470f0 no longer stops multiplayer during a summoned map reload: its call at 0x19471b1 to CSMultiPlayMan::Stop 0x1ed07a0 calls the class's matching-exists predicate 0x1ed00a0 instead (same success branch, the room stays).

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Party: SOS sign timeout 30s
Metadata.Author: bbport, after Wozzardman/shadp2p
Metadata.Note: Party co-op: a sign in the SOS status list (0x1872360) expires after 30 s instead of 180 s (float at 0x4927a5c, read only there), so an unanswered bell is renewed by the party director sooner. The 55 s float next to it is unchanged.

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Party: Skip Online/Offline Choice (Online)
Metadata.Author: bbport, after Wozzardman/shadp2p
Metadata.Note: Party co-op variant of Skip Online/Offline Choice: the dialog builder 0x1b39030 returns what its PLAY ONLINE item returns (operator() 0x1b49eb0 of item functor vtable 0x533be80; the same as PLAY OFFLINE 0x1b49cd0 with the online flag 1), so the game goes to the main menu online. patches.py uses it for BB_SKIP_NETWORK_CHOICE=online.

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Party: Bells without Insight
Metadata.Author: bbport
Metadata.Note: Party co-op (BB_PARTY; BB_PARTY_BELL_NO_INSIGHT=0 or BB_PARTY_SEAMLESS=0 turns it off): a goods item's Insight cost (EquipParamGoods consumeHeroPoint +0x38; 1 for the Beckoning Bell 200) neither greys it out nor is spent. Availability 0x157f200: setg al at 0x157fa5c (cost > Insight) -> xor al,al; goods use 0x18c9160: movzx eax,[goods+0x38]; neg eax (the Insight delta) at 0x18c92bb -> xor eax,eax. The party layer also writes the Beckoning Bell row's cost to 0 at run time.

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Party: Fast multiplayer messages
Metadata.Author: bbport
Metadata.Note: Party co-op (BB_PARTY; BB_PARTY_FAST_MESSAGES=0 turns it off): the multiplayer banner (Scaleform SummonMessage dialog, update 0x1bff910; FMG EventText 100001..200000: bell searching / discovered, X has arrived, entered the world of X, died, returning to own world, farewell) holds 1.5 s instead of 5.0 s. The fades are the movie's own (about 0.17 s in, 0.23 s out). 0x1bfface mov dword [r13],5.0 (a new message) and the rodata 5.0 at 0x4928a98, read only at 0x1bffa7d (re-show after a cutscene). docs/party/join_timing.md.

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Party: Hide bell searching messages
Metadata.Author: bbport
Metadata.Note: Party co-op (BB_PARTY; BB_PARTY_FAST_MESSAGES=0 turns it off): the party director rings the bells itself, so the "Searching for the chime of a Beckoning Bell / Small Resonant Bell..." banners (100100/100110, 100001/100011) are not shown; the bell itself (SpEffect, sign, sound) is unchanged. 0x1389cfc: the tail jmp to ShowSummonMessage 0x1bffe80 after the epilogue -> ret; 0x17c3cea: call 0x1bffe80 (result unused) -> 5-byte nop. docs/party/join_timing.md.

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Party: Fast join
Metadata.Author: bbport
Metadata.Note: Party co-op (BB_PARTY; BB_PARTY_FAST_JOIN=0 turns it off): the game's fixed summon / join pauses, none of which waits for data (docs/party/join_timing.md). CSEnterleaveDirectionStep timers (static initializer 0x196d3a0): guest self-prologue 0x5574ad0 5.0 -> 0.1 s (STEP_C2H_Wait_forSelfPrologue 0x196b500; the guest's loading of the host world waits for it), others-epilogue cap 0x5574ad8 5.0 -> 1.0 s (0x196be90 ends earlier when the effect is done), return-home wait 0x5574ae0 5.0 -> 1.0 s and its fade 0x5574ae8 2.0 -> 0.5 s (STEP_H2C_Wait_forEffect 0x196c2d0). Host summon message (SummonStepManager tick 0x14b5e10): the check whether the summoned guest is a connected peer before the summon data goes out repeats every 0.5 s instead of 3.0 s (0x14b80c4), with 16 tries instead of 5 (0x14b4975, 0x14bb067: an 8 s window instead of 15 s; a summon that fails ends sooner and the sign is offered again). NexusRevolution transport defaults (0xcdb250): the first retransmission timeout 3000 -> 300 ms (0xcdb2e8; the guest's session connect on vport 30 crosses the host's and is resent only after it), like TCP's initial RTO.

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Party: Fast rejoin
Metadata.Author: bbport
Metadata.Note: Party co-op (BB_PARTY; BB_PARTY_FAST_JOIN=0 turns it off): the host's peer pool (0x147b350) keeps a peer reserved for a summoned player's online id 10 s instead of 30 s after the last use (+0xe4 keep flag, +0xe8 timer; 0x147af20 renews it on every summon retry, 0x1480d10 counts it down and re-arms it while the player is a session member). A guest that crashed and restarted is summoned again once the stale reservation lapses (docs/party/join_timing.md).

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Party: Fast bell sign
Metadata.Author: bbport
Metadata.Note: Party co-op (with BB_PARTY_FAST_JOIN; BB_PARTY_FAST_SIGN=0 turns it off alone): the bell sign sender (vtable 0x532f390; update 0x18a9350 counts +0x28 down, then SendSign 0x1901320, then 30 s to the next resend) sends the first sign 2.0 s after a bell instead of 5.0 s: start functions 0x18a9250 / 0x18a9280 (0x18a9264 / 0x18a9324) and the ten inlined starts of sign kinds 1..10 (0x189a095 + n*0x110). docs/party/join_timing.md.
